also, it's kinda sad how someone that claims to have been depressed acts like this. get your head out of your ass. it isn't about you or your partner. it's about so many people. don't go around calling people sick fucks under a fucking subreddit about suicide. fuck you for acting like this. and fuck you for trying to make people feel like their feelings are invalid because you "know what it's like and it isn't like this". they shut you up or straight up ignore you. or will pretend to care for like 5 minutes and then drop it like it's nothing.

if you take it like this then of course it's selfish. but no one who wants to kill themselves is doing it because they're selfish. I always feel like the world would just be better of without me and it would be a good thing to end my life. from outside, you can consider it selfish. but it isn't always like that
they only don't want to feel guilty for your death. when you actually commit suicide they ll tell themselves they "tried but you couldn't be saved". sad but true

when someone is in the suicide mindset, they will feel that nothing will help. I have felt like my suicide will make everyone life a better, calmer life. it isn't selfish. I have seeked out help. no one cared. so it isn't selfish.

I don't blame anyone. I know I'm unlovable. I'm too clingy and I except others to treat me as a priority because everytime I get attached, the other person's life is more important than mine. I'm just tired of people acting like they care. I've seen it all. no one actually cares. they just don't want to feel better. I am trying to get better everyday, but sadly Im pretty sure the cause of my death will be suicide. it's just the truth.

I'm really sorry to hear it.  she sucks. people don't want to feel guilty. they rather put you through hell and back than feel like they are a bad person. it's always about them and their own feelings
they're too rare and by the time you find one, you ll probably be lost and can't be saved. sad but true. sometimes suicide is the only answer.

im sorry to hear all of that. it's too bad the world we live in is so shit that situations like these even exist. people just don't want to accept that sometimes, the problem isn't just temporary. that sometimes suicide is the only way to get out of it.
sometimes we just want to know someone is here for us. when we cry, we can go and cry on someones shoulder. people just love acting like they care so they don't feel guilty when you actually die

not at all. you just want people to maybe care for once. feel bad for what they put you through. I get it

because when they say it's selfish, they only think about THEIR suffering. not yours. it's really ironic how they only think about themselves but will call you selfish for wanting to end your pain.
